answer_1.quote: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable performance across a wide range of tasks ... Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) provides an effective solution to these problems . By integrating an external retriever, the LLMs can access relevant knowledge based on user input queries, thus producing more accurate and reliable ... responses.
answer_1.outputs: The outputs are generated responses to open-domain question-answering queries, synthesized using retrieved knowledge and multi-step reasoning through a modular RAG framework.

answer_2.quote: Exact match (EM) and F1 score are employed as evaluation metrics.
